settings.text:
Selecting the right head shape, length, and weights for your Never Compromise Putter unlocks your body's own biomechanics for more consistent strokes and better performance on the greens.

While there's no substitute for an in-person fitting by your local Never Compromise fitting expert, you can still build the perfect Putter using the steps below.
Select your ideal model based on your stroke type and preferred head shape.

For a classic look with minimal distraction during your stroke, select Tour Satin (top).

For high-contrast alignment that frames the ball, select the NC Contrast finish (bottom).

Use our simple height chart to determine which length is ideal for your new Never Compromise Putter. Remember, our length system is most effective when paired with an ideal putting stance and setup. Here's how you get there:

  • Tuck your elbows to your ribs and, while keeping your back straight, bend at the waist until your eyes are directly over the ball.
  • Slightly bend your knees, shift your weight forward, and extend your arms from your body until your hands hang below your shoulders
  • Grip your putter

Use these three easy tips to maintain ideal posture:

  1. Eyes Over the Ball
  2. Hands Under the Shoulders
  3. Hips Over the Heels

Use this chart to select the recommended sole weights for your fitted Putter length. Our recommendations create a consistent, stable swing feel across the line, regardless of length. If you prefer putting with a heavy or light feel, you may adjust your weight selection accordingly.
Choose our Standard or Oversize pistol grip based on your preference or our Stroke Type recommendations.
